name: com.globalhostia/store
title: GlobalHostia
description: Domains, DNS, hosting, VPS, SSL and email: live prices, domain checks, orders and account tools.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Best first call when the user describes what they need in words. Picks up to 10 live GlobalHostia plans that fit a need (e.g. "WordPress blog", "Windows VPS for MT5", "n8n automation", "reseller hosting for 20 clients", "dedicated server in Germany"), with an optional monthly budget, location, OS, minimum RAM and number of websites. Returns ranked plans with the reason for each, live price, specs and cart link.

need.description: What the customer wants to run or host, in plain words.

budget_monthly.description: Maximum monthly-equivalent price in the chosen currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

location.description: Preferred datacenter location, e.g. USA, Germany, Singapore.

os.description: Operating system preference, e.g. Windows, Ubuntu, Linux.

websites.description: Number of websites to host (shared, WordPress, reseller).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Keyword search over every GlobalHostia hosting, server, SSL and email plan, with filters for category, location and maximum monthly price. Returns matching plans with key specs, location, cheapest live price, product page and cart link. Prefer recommend_plan when the user describes a need rather than keywords.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "windows vps 8gb ram", "wordpress", "dedicated server usa". Leave empty to browse a category.

category.description: Category slug or name from list_categories.

max_price.description: Maximum monthly-equivalent price in the chosen currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

location.description: Datacenter location, e.g. USA, Germany, Singapore.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything about one plan by slug: description, specs, included and excluded features, location, availability, and every billing cycle with its price, setup fee, monthly equivalent and cart link.

slug.description: Product slug as returned by search_products, recommend_plan or list_categories.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 plans by slug: specs, price for every billing cycle (with setup fee and monthly equivalent), location and top features. Use after search_products or recommend_plan when the user is choosing between options.

items.description: Product slug as returned by search_products, recommend_plan or list_categories.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every product category with a one-line summary, number of plans, starting price and page link, plus all datacenter locations and supported currencies. Good for browsing or when a search returns nothing.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Live registry check of one domain name (e.g. mybrand.com, mybrand.ae): whether it is available, first-year registration price, renewal and transfer price, and an add-to-cart link. If taken, returns a link to the domain broker service. Limited to 10 checks per minute.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Ready-to-pay cart deep link for one plan with the billing cycle and currency preselected, optionally attaching a domain to the hosting order. Returns the exact price and setup fee for that cycle. Give the link to the customer to finish checkout. To register a new domain, use the link from check_domain (domainOnlyCartUrl is also returned).

slug.description: Product slug as returned by search_products, recommend_plan or list_categories.

billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle; must be one the plan offers (see get_product). Defaults to monthly when offered, else the shortest cycle.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

domain.description: Optional domain to use with the hosting plan, e.g. mybrand.com.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: GlobalHostia customer policies summarised from the published Terms & Conditions: money-back guarantee, domain and SSL refunds, cancellation, automatic renewal and price changes, billing, taxes and VAT, domain expiry and data retention, with the source link. Use before answering any refund, VAT or renewal question.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: NLWeb-style question answering over the GlobalHostia site: a natural-language question returns ranked results (plans, domain prices, policies, REVAULT and site features such as bulk domain search, the domain watchlist, Spark and the AI connectors), each with a schema.org object. Use when no more specific tool fits.

query.description: The question, e.g. "cheapest VPS in Singapore" or "do you refund domains?"

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: Same as build_cart_link without a domain; kept for existing clients.

slug.description: Product slug as returned by search_products, recommend_plan or list_categories.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.
